title: Silently crash on GetQuotaObjectForFile
body:
User Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.1; Win64; x64; rv:109.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/115.0

Steps to reproduce:

Put on upload 16 videos in total amount of 64 GB into youtube.
All goes on private browsing.


Actual results:

Browser silently crash after while. I start it again - no any crash reporter window. Put upload again - again crash after while. After 3 crashes i finally able end upload.

Such not be issues on 114. I turn off http3 on 115, for make full speed upload.

Crash data always same:

xul.dll 115.0.2.8591 
at 0x00000000027028d5
with 0xc0000005

additional info:
C:\Symbols\xul.pdb\567F69B6E873E30E4C4C44205044422E1\xul.pdb

No crash.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: I mostly not care about crash reporting. i care about stability. So need fix crash issues in first place, not provide working crash reporter.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
Usually there memory leak. In child process. 

And when it reach 17 GB it stop upload at all. Just make spikes on memory usage. Drop it few GB, and load back. But no actual bytes transfer over net.

If it too big, tab can crash. In v114. So can be restarted. But in v115, it can suddenly crash whole FF.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
I try run firefox under WinDbg. It not help. It start firefox as additional child process from WinDbg, and later goes all other process. So when it crash, WinDbg happily look at empty stub firefox process and not notice anything.

Crash again in same place. No any crash reporter. It be upload 18 GB before crash. So this mean not less from 25 minutes on each try, before crash.

Issue related to Private Browsing. And reproduced on 115.0.3esr.

I start clean profile, where significant change - disable http3.

I upload 30 videos of 2 GB each in normal mode and not get any crash. 15 videos per each batch.

After I open Private browsing and start upload same videos. 

Fast enough I got crash:
0xc0000005 at 0x0000000002702975 in xul.dll, version: 115.0.3.8599

It crashed on try upload 6th file from 15 in the first batch.

comments.author: reporter

I test it again. Results is same:

0xc0000005 at 0x0000000002702975 in xul.dll, version: 115.0.3.8599

2. Clean start Firefox, start upload 15 videos of 2 GB each, on Usual Browsing. Result - No crash. All 15 videos uploaded.

comments.author: participant3
comments.body: How much unused disk space you have left on your system? Private browsing uses more disk space because of encryption than the regular mode. I am not sure why we are trying to write such big amounts in IndexedDB for uploads. But could you somehow free up some of your system's disk space and try this again (it would be better if you could try with double free memory with what you are trying now). It was mentioned that this upload worked for ff versions < 115. That upload worked in Private Browsing mode or regular mode < 115 ?

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
20.3 GB free on system drive.

Crash happen on less from 11 GB uploaded in private browsing mode.

Upload worked in private browsing mode for FF < 115. There be crashes, but they mostly be caused by overflow RAM.

Look like it now try use disk and on my system disk overflow much faster, then RAM.

comments.author: participant4
comments.body:
It seems the problem is this static cast:
https://searchfox.org/mozilla-central/rev/8d43262674d6c6d469b821cca579b1240ebb42a5/storage/QuotaVFS.cpp#615

That works fine when IndexedDB uses the QuotaVFS directly, but it can't work well when IndexedDB uses ObfuscatingVFS (which then forwards stuff to QuotaVFS).

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
It crash again on 6th file. There be 10.4 GB free on system drive, little before crash.
Right after crash it make 14.4 GB free.

So I guess this happen not because free space ended, but since some file hit some limit, which start call stuff for detect quota, which end on this call, where happen wrong cast.

comments.author: participant4
comments.body: Yeah, it's probably the 10GB group limit and some JS code tries to free some space when it gets the quota exceeded error from IndexedDB.

Look at right guess about 10 GB quota. Now here 5 files in total of 9.9 GB. It upload now 5th file. Previous 4 uploaded, so this space can be free, but it not free it.

When there start upload 6th file, there appear 6th file, but fast gone. Upload work near 5-10 seconds and browser crash.

So it look like files in size goes more then 10 GB. Start some clean up, this clean up delete wrong file (last one, instead of old, first for example). So possible object in memory freed. So when memory buffer end, it try do stuff on freed memory, 

or on wrong object, make wrong cast,

Not sure what this more possible. But since file gone from file system, I suspect related object to it, in the memory, will be freed too.

So possible cast ok, but object already freed.
